        for date_key, date_val in dj.items():
            if isinstance(date_val, dict):

                prices.pop('premium_economy', None)
                avail = date_val.get('available_seats', {})
                avail.pop('premium_economy', None)
        dates_json = json.dumps(dj)

    cur.execute("UPDATE flights SET cabin_prices_json=?, dates_json=? WHERE flight_id=?",
